preconditions.expression: t == int(t) and t > 0 and t <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(n == int(n) and n > 0 and n <= 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each test case's length n is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(a_i == int(a_i) and a_i > 0 and a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the sequence is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the sum of weights of all subsegments of the sequence a, where the weight of a subsegment is the number of unordered pairs (i, j) with i < j and a_i == a_j.

postconditions.expression: sum_of_weights(a) == sum(sum(weight(subsegment) for subsegment in subsegments(a)) for a in test_cases)
postconditions.description: The sum of weights is computed by summing the weights of all possible subsegments of a, where a subsegment is any contiguous subsequence obtained by deleting elements from the start and/or end.

postconditions.expression: weight(subsegment) == sum(1 for i in range(len(subsegment)) for j in range(i+1, len(subsegment)) if subsegment[i] == subsegment[j])
postconditions.description: The weight of a subsegment is the count of unordered pairs (i, j) with i < j and subsegment[i] == subsegment[j].
